caveats: Measured on a shared 48-core host under heavy concurrent load (load average ~50); an idle host would be materially faster. These are scheduling estimates, not a speed benchmark -- WS8.1 owns matched-hardware timing.
Batching into 2 balanced halves adds one extra diamond fixed cost per set (~7 %).
Prodigal is skipped for set_C_clean/set_D_clean because deterministic gene calls from the completed proGenomes runs are reused (verified bit-identical).
